extraits.texte: This product split open at the top the very first time I used it. Literally went to squeeze some in my hand and it shot out of a hole at the top. Other that that total bummer, smells good and smooth. Could be a bit more exfoliating

Really happy with the actual face scrub but I have had two tubes that the top blew out with the first squeeze. I returned the first and they replaced it but the replacement bottle did the same thing. At this point, I don’t want to deal with the hassle of returning again so I will just throw some duct tape on there. But I have to knock down the review if immediately upon receiving the product I have to perform at home repairs!

extraits.titre: Compared to Lab Series Face Scrub
extraits.texte: I was looking for a replacement for Lab Series product since it has become scarce and expensive recently. I tried a few products before but none of them was even close to the Lab Series product until I stumbled on Marlowe No. 122. To be clear, Lab Series is still the superior product, however Marlowe is a good replacement at about 1/4 of the price (per volume). Here are some of the highlights: * Nice smell, very subtle and not overwhelming at all * Good scrubbing particles (although I would prefer them to be a bit larger) * Good complexion, not too oily or watery * Nice size bottle (similar look and colors to Lab Series but much larger) Overall very recommended product for an affordable price.

extraits.titre: smells absolutely wonderful & can be used on troubled scalp (& rest of body, too)!
extraits.texte: sweet, vanilla with some fresh greens scent... goes on smooth & creamy... it's not drying! looked for days to find a skin scrub that can be used on troubled scalp (no problematic oils...). I use it on the body during showers... put a dime sized dot on wash cloth & spread. it's also economical, especially on subscribe; it's a big tube. great, thanks! update, 3/13/26: the scrubbing grains are rather large & their ratio to what they're suspended in is low... (wish Giovanni D:tox product with charcoal and volcanic ash was in stock; got it at a grocery store years ago & it lasted and lasted... it's "dense" -- it's about nothing but scrubbing... and, unlike with this Marlowe, the grains really are fine...) the good thing with this is, besides it being okay for use on scalp... how creamy, spreadable & non-drying it is.

This is an awesome product, and one that seems to go under the radar. It has an awesome scent, masculine, but not overpowering, and the scrubbing material is just the right size to work wonderfully well. I usually use this straight after shaving, and it’s moisturizing properties are fantastic!!

I am a woman so I obviously didn’t use this myself but I had my boyfriend try this.. and he loves it! He has all his personal care items in sandal wood scent so he was so excited about this product. He has really bad skin. He breaks out and has oily skin. He said after using this his skin felt so fresh and new.! He said he would definitely get this again

extraits.titre: At last I found one that does the job
extraits.texte: I have oily skin. Used lots of different facial soaps for men. This one works great. Have ordered multiple times

reserve: Only 16 reviews were available and most focus on scent and packaging rather than skin type or concerns, so segment and concern coverage is limited to oily skin, hydration and blemishes.
